perks.name: Perkpocalypse
perks.text: Activates all perks of another mayor every 18 SkyBlock days (6 hours).

perks.name: Statspocalypse
perks.text: Increases all Combat and Miscellaneous stats by 10%.

perks.name: Jerrypocalypse
perks.text: Reveal hidden Jerries from logging, farming, mining and killing mobs.
